navigation_extrapolation.scope: Log-line counts, not unique incidents or controller ticks; full original log archived. Missing lines or logs are not proof of no TF errors.

tf_diagnostics.scope: Node logs only its first attempted age-rejection diagnostic; counts do not measure all rejected lookups and logger failure may omit an event. Decision now/age and event-emission stamp are distinct.

navigation.note: Terminal failure includes cancellation; timeout classification uses explicit recorded reasons only.

accepted_file_inventory.scope: Presence inventory only, not hashes, receipt validity, or a passing strict audit. Missing expected files are never fabricated.

shutdown.limitation: SIGKILL cannot guarantee bounded exit from uninterruptible kernel I/O

retention.audit_scope: Existing closed-run audit result, not a second raw-image decode or independent TF-accuracy test.

writer_transport.scope: Union of available bounded writer_history snapshots, deduplicated by operation_id; successful checkpoint-only workers are not normally included and earlier jobs may have rolled out. Times are owner samples, not child read/import/fsync timings. Unknown is not zero; no whole-run throughput or root-cause claim.

parent_launch.scope: Parent samples around process creation, identity persistence and one-byte gate release; exact child scheduling is not inferred.
parent_launch.name: motion

parent_wait.scope: Parent observation of the collector dual-stream readiness marker; not child emission time or motion verification.

collector_startup_timing.clock: time.monotonic; host wall clock, not ROS simulation time
collector_startup_timing.scope: Main entry excludes interpreter/top-level imports; READY is loop observation of both streams. Environment stamp is optional wrapper observation, including wrapper startup.

parent_popen_call.scope: Parent Popen call only; child startup can continue after return.

parent_identity_persistence.scope: Parent identity write/atomic replace duration before the gate release.

parent_gate_write_call.scope: Parent samples bracket the one-byte release; neither sample is the exact child wake time.

gate_write_start_to_environment_wrapper.scope: Contains bootstrap scheduling, bash/ROS overlay setup and lightweight wrapper startup; does not isolate overlay sourcing.

gate_write_completed_to_environment_wrap.scope: Post-write parent sample can occur after child execution; a negative interval is retained as unusable duration, never clamped to zero.

environment_wrapper_to_main_enter.scope: Wrapper timestamp precedes its print/exec; includes those operations, normal interpreter startup and collector top-level imports before main entry.

main_enter_to_runtime_load_start.scope: Argument parsing, report setup and initial persistence/logging after main entry; excludes top-level imports.

runtime_load.scope: Measured load_runtime call; not per-library import profiling.

runtime_loaded_to_subscriptions_ready.scope: ROS initialization, node/listener/subscription creation and native transport setup, before loop readiness observation.

subscriptions_to_collector_both_streams.scope: Collector loop observation of both native/odom sample buffers; not exact sensor publication or callback-arrival time.

collector_both_streams_to_parent_observa.scope: Between child loop observation sampled before printing and parent post-log-read observation; includes scheduling, printing and polling.

parent_wait_to_marker_observation.scope: Time consumed within the parent readiness wait; not the complete lifetime from process creation.

parent_effective_wait_budget.scope: Effective budget after clipping to the unchanged global deadline; requested allowance is recorded separately.

parent_observation_to_wait_deadline.scope: Remaining observed budget if nonnegative; a negative signed difference means a late parent observation.

gate_write_start_to_parent_observation.scope: Whole gate-write-start to parent readiness observation interval; the release event itself lies within its recorded bracket.

startup_timing.scope: Same-run declared CLOCK_MONOTONIC diagnostics only, not ROS simulation time. Missing/negative/invalid intervals have no duration. Main entry excludes top-level imports; environment wrapper time includes its startup. Parent readiness observation is not a child timestamp or motion verification.

native.scope: Same native model sampled at home and final observer time; no map/world identity assumption.

conventions.origin: metric lower-left corner of cell (0,0); yaw in radians, no half-cell shift
conventions.yaml_thresholds: fixed Nav2 trinary reload thresholds; distinct from input classification

limitations: No live map service was called or repaired; source report is unchanged.
Trinary export preserves unknowns and classifies intermediate probabilities as unknown; raw probabilities remain in source JSON.
YAML has no frame field; use the recorded frame_id when configuring map_server.
File readback does not prove complete mapping, visual coverage, navigation safety, or mission success.

map_export.scope: Separate captured OccupancyGrid raster and posegraph service; not a save_map service repair.

cleanup.cleanup_budget_note: Each owned group adds at most 20+5+3 seconds of signal polling, excluding scheduling/I/O delays.
cleanup.global_scan_limitation: Some same-UID /proc environments unreadable; no global absence claim
cleanup.owned_cleanup_scope: Verified launched process groups, nested recorder and exact writer child exit

run_token_cleanup_context.scope: Ancillary evidence only; does not override the original incomplete global scan.

Owned groups and the retained-frame writer have closure evidence; global token absence remains as reported, including permission failures.
A bounded queue of processed-frame windows does not establish whole-maze visual coverage or target recall.
Saved online claims and closed-run artifact audit have different scopes; missing evidence is not a pass.
Native stationary brackets/tails are sampled evidence, not a continuous-motion proof.
